premises.text: Mainstream social media exposes kids to predatory algorithms, addictive loops, strangers, compromised data, and inappropriate content, and is not built for them
premises.evidence_span: social media has some challenges, like predatory algorithms, addictive behavioral loops that reinforce toxic mindsets, strangers and creepers

premises.text: Betweened supports kids' digital literacy with kid-friendly creator tools, authentic profiles, and guided socially appropriate communication
premises.evidence_span: Betweened is a platform that will support kids' digital literacy while providing the entertainment and education, the interaction that they crave

premises.text: Parents can turn tools on and off and customize the platform by age, stage, and preferences via a guided curriculum
premises.evidence_span: we provide parental tools that can be turned on and off, because kids shouldn't have access to all of the tools right off the bat

premises.text: Feed content is curated and moderated by developmental experts, includes pause moments, and requires verified parental consent
premises.evidence_span: it is curated and moderated by experts, by adults trained in developmental psychology and in our editorial guidelines

premises.text: Launch starts with curated content to jumpstart engagement and network effects, then adds social features via invitations and brand partnerships
premises.evidence_span: we're intentionally starting with content for our beta, because this addresses a major pain point for parents, age-appropriate content. But it also ensures that Between is engaging from the start, allowing us to jumpstart network effects

domains.name: Mindful kid platform and parental controls

value.text: Course-correct social media so kids grow up thoughtful and practiced in how they engage with technology
value.evidence_span: Betweened is how we course correct social media for kids around the world, ensuring that the millions of kids, my daughter included, grow up thoughtful and practiced in all that they do

secondary_value.text: Deepen emotional bonds by creating together with friends, siblings, and parents
secondary_value.evidence_span: creating together not only heightens the learning and the skills that are learned through that, but it also deepens emotional bonds

causal_links.evidence_span: Nor should we give kids social media just because the privacy laws say that they're now old enough
support kids' digital literacy while providing the entertainment and education
jumpstart network effects and data required to build a social graph
